key: Hrmm... I appear to have misplaced a present I got for my grandson.
en: Hrmm... I appear to have misplaced a present I got for my grandson.
ja: ふーむ……孫のために買ったプレゼントを、どこかに置き忘れてしまったようだ。
これは実に困ったことだ……

key: Trainer, should you happen to find it, I shall see to it that you are showered with presents in return.
en: Trainer, should you happen to find it, I shall see to it that you are showered with presents in return.
ja: トレーナーよ、もし見つけたら、お礼にたくさんのプレゼントを浴びせようではないか。
待て!

key: That Gift Box you have that-- that one right there?!
en: That Gift Box you have that-- that one right there?!
ja: その、持っているギフトボックス――それだ、それだ!?
もしや――そうだ!
すぐにこちらへ渡すのだ!
\PNはギフトボックスを渡した。

key: You've found it and I am saved!
en: You've found it and I am saved!
ja: 見つけてくれたのだな、救われた!

key: Three cheers for the hero of the day!
en: Three cheers for the hero of the day!
ja: 今日のヒーローに、万歳三唱を!
いや、それ以上だ!

key: As promised, you shall be showered with no small number of presents!
en: As promised, you shall be showered with no small number of presents!
ja: 約束通り、少なくない数のプレゼントを浴びせようではないか!
さあ、来るぞ……!
……何だと? 「プレゼント」を無限に使えるのか!

key: Don't you dare act disappointed! I've filled my end of the promise!
en: Don't you dare act disappointed! I've filled my end of the promise!
ja: がっかりした顔をするでない! わしはちゃんと約束を果たしたぞ!

key: Say, do you want to know what was in the Gift Box?
en: Say, do you want to know what was in the Gift Box?
ja: ときに、ギフトボックスの中身が何だったか知りたいか?

key: Well-- I'll tell you, but it must be a secret from all.
en: Well-- I'll tell you, but it must be a secret from all.
ja: よろしい――教えてやろう、だが他言は無用だぞ。
よし……
よく聞くのだ。
実はな……
箱の中には……
あったのは……
友情の魔法だ!
すごいだろう?
冗談だよ。
7万ドルの腕時計だった。

key: If you go down the tracks right outside, it'll lead you underneath the Obsidia Ward.
en: If you go down the tracks right outside, it'll lead you underneath the Obsidia Ward.
ja: すぐ外の線路を進めば、オブシディア区の地下に出る。

key: Too bad part of it caved in.
en: Too bad part of it caved in.
ja: 一部が崩落してしまったのが残念だがな。

key: I hear the city's finally trying to rebuild the Railnet.
en: I hear the city's finally trying to rebuild the Railnet.
ja: ついに街が鉄道網の再建に乗り出したと聞いたぞ。

key: I think kids have been going and playing down there lately, so maybe that's a good thing.
en: I think kids have been going and playing down there lately, so maybe that's a good thing.
ja: 最近、子供たちがあそこに遊びに行ってるみたいだから、いいことなのかもな。

key: I'm going to be evicted soon, I know it.
en: I'm going to be evicted soon, I know it.
ja: もうすぐ立ち退きさせられる、それは分かってる。

key: I've made my life as a sailor, but Coral Pier shut down when Azurine Lake became too acidic for even boats to cross over.
en: I've made my life as a sailor, but Coral Pier shut down when Azurine Lake became too acidic for even boats to cross over.
ja: 船乗りとして生きてきたが、アズリン湖が船すら渡れないほど酸性化して、コーラル桟橋は閉鎖されちまった。
もう何週間も働いてない……
